card.title: Self-Service Checkouts
card.passage: Many supermarkets have introduced self-service checkouts. Customers scan the products they buy and pay by themselves. Supermarkets can reduce the number of workers needed at checkouts, and in this way they can save money. However, some older customers find these machines difficult to use, so staff members are still needed to help them.

card.title: Bicycle-Sharing Services
card.passage: In many cities, people can rent bicycles from bicycle-sharing services. Users can borrow a bicycle at one station and return it at another. People can ride bicycles instead of taking taxis, and in this way they can save money. However, some users leave bicycles in the wrong places, so cities need to make clear rules.

Restaurants can sell food to people who cannot come to the restaurant, and in this way they can get more customers. They can use English in real situations, and by doing so they can improve their communication skills. However, trips abroad cost a lot of money, so some families find it hard to pay for them.
